greeting.text: A hooded rat eyes you from beneath a tattered cloak. 'Well, well... what do we have here? Lost, are we?'

choices.text: Do you have anything to trade?

threaten.text: The rat bares his teeth. 'You found it.' He lunges!

neutral.text: 'Sure you are.' He tosses you a coin. 'Buy yourself something better than that excuse.'

trade.text: He scratches his chin. 'Information costs. But I'll let you have this one free.' He slips you a pouch.

refuse.text: 'Smart.' He almost sounds impressed. 'Get out of here before I change my mind.'
